backend/main.mo: Motoko canister implementing story submission, commenting, user profiles, and admin moderation with access control.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report mapping features to affected frontend files and components with confidence levels.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Prewritten summaries describing the purpose of each frontend file in the app.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base stylesheet defining OKLCH color variables, themes, and global element styles.
frontend/index.html: App entry HTML mounting the React root and loading the main module script.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Sets up TanStack Router routes and root layout for feed, submit, story detail, admin, and about pages.
frontend/src/components/AccessDeniedStat: UI component displaying an access-denied message with a return-to-home action.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Header with logo and navigation buttons for browsing stories and submitting new ones.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Page layout wrapper providing header, main content area, and footer with About link.
Form component allowing users to create and submit comments on a story.
frontend/src/components/CommentThread.ts: Displays a list of comments for a story with timestamps, loading states, and error handling.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and caches a backend actor based on Internet Identity and refreshes dependent queries when the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useAdmin.ts: Provides admin hooks to fetch all stories and publish reworded stories with react-query mutations.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity provider and hook for managing authentication state and loading identities.
frontend/src/hooks/useStories.ts: Exposes hooks for fetching published stories, individual stories, comments, and submitting stories or comments.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind-based styling and theme variables for light and dark editorial-style UI.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with react-query and Internet Identity provider setup.
frontend/src/pages/AboutPage.tsx: Renders an About page describing the author and purpose of the storytelling platform.
frontend/src/pages/AdminModerationPage.t: Admin interface for reviewing, editing, and publishing submitted stories with access control handling.
frontend/src/pages/FeedPage.tsx: Displays a feed of published stories with hero section, loading states, and navigation to individual stories.
frontend/src/pages/StoryDetailPage.tsx: Displays a full published story with metadata, handles loading/error states, and embeds comment composer and thread.
frontend/src/pages/SubmitStoryPage.tsx: Provides a story submission form with optional anonymity and shows a confirmation view after successful submission.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utility helpers for reading, persisting, and clearing URL parameters with sessionStorage support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining typography, container settings, custom colors, animations, and plugins.
project_state.json: Project state file describing app purpose, features, issues, and versioned requirements metadata.
